@router.patch("/api/v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/seats")
async def update_seat_allocation(
    sub_id: str,
    seats: int = Body(..., embed=True),
    redis_client: Redis = Depends(get_redis),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    async with redis_distributed_lock(redis_client, f"sub_lock:{sub_id}", timeout=10.0):
        stmt = select(CompanySubscription).where(
            CompanySubscription.id == sub_id,
            CompanySubscription.company_id == current_user.company_id
        )
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        subscription = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not subscription:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Subscription not found")
        if seats < subscription.min_seats or seats > subscription.max_seats:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Seat count out of plan bounds")
        subscription.allocated_seats = seats
        await db.commit()
    return {"subscription_id": sub_id, "allocated_seats": seats}
